theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_bl_rb_null_seq_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (f h : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (s : ℕ → ℝ), C ≠ ∞ → (∀ i, 0 < s i) → Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 0) → (limsup f (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ 1 → limsup (fun i => C * f (s i)) atTop ≤ C) ∧ (Tendsto h (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun i => C * h (s i)) atTop (𝓝 0))
